strings.faq_title: FAQ OEM Chau Cay: MOQ, Lead Time va Dieu Khoan Xuat Khau
strings.faq_desc: Cau tra loi thuc te cho nguoi mua nhap khau ve chau cay OEM, nhan rieng, chinh sach MOQ va lead time don lon.
strings.faq_q1: MOQ cho don chau cay OEM va nhan rieng la bao nhieu?
strings.faq_a1: MOQ phu thuoc vao nhom san pham va muc do tuy chinh. Da so SKU tieu chuan bat dau tu 50-500 pcs, trong khi du an logo OEM va bao bi rieng thuong can so luong cao hon de on dinh don gia.
strings.faq_q2: Lead time lam mau va lead time san xuat don lon bao lau?
strings.faq_a2: Lead time lam mau thuong 5-10 ngay cho lua chon tieu chuan. Don lon thuong 20-35 ngay sau khi dat coc va chot artwork, va nen co them buffer vao mua cao diem.
strings.faq_q3: Ban co ho tro logo OEM, mau sac tuy chinh va bao bi thuong hieu khong?
strings.faq_a3: Co. Chung toi ho tro in logo OEM, mau tuy chinh, tem barcode, insert card va carton san sang cho ban le. Tinh kha thi cuoi cung phu thuoc vao dong san pham, so luong va lich giao hang.
strings.faq_q4: Ban ho tro Incoterms nao va cang dich nao?
strings.faq_a4: Dieu khoan pho bien gom FOB va CIF, va chung toi co the sap xep giao hang den cac cang chinh tai Dong Nam A. Cung cap som cang dich va timeline se giup chot gia nhanh hon.
strings.faq_q5: Can thong tin gi de nhan bao gia ban si chinh xac nhanh nhat?
strings.faq_a5: Vui long cung cap loai san pham, so luong, nhu cau OEM, cang dich, thang giao hang muc tieu va tieu chuan dong goi. RFQ day du giup chung toi phan hoi bao gia chinh xac trong 24 gio lam viec.
strings.contact_desc: Bieu mau inquiry da giu cac truong ma nguoi mua B2B thuong can: cong ty, quoc gia, OEM, cang dich va thoi diem giao hang.

strings.contact_info_4_desc: Dieu khoan tham chieu: MOQ theo SKU, phi mau duoc tru vao don lon, ho tro FOB/CIF, thanh toan 30/70 TT.
